mission_result: Implemented an isolated, reopenable multi-surface Control candidate for control-plan, Prometeo móvil, Facultad Digital / Study Library and Alumnos / página docente. The candidate renders typed derived state for intent/thread evidence, active workers, durable returns, local integration state, preview/open availability and useful free-worker capacity while explicitly keeping Live/telemetry non-authoritative and refusing guessed routes or candidate self-promotion.

local_function_equivalent_probe.limitation: The GitHub connector does not expose a checked-out repository runtime, so the committed node:test file was not executed in-place during this run.

preserved_invariants: Exactly one Universal Control remains global; no second served shell was mounted.
Live/telemetry remains a derived projection, never durable source of truth.
Candidate data cannot self-promote Human Accepted, Current or Served.
Unknown routes stay UNRESOLVED and cannot carry a guessed href.
Served Universal Control V5 payload, Favorites, Corner Anchor and persistence authority remain untouched.
Sample data is explicitly SAMPLE_NOT_LIVE rather than presented as actual worker/progress truth.

self_critique_and_repair.finding: The first executable candidate rendered Hilo / intención as a button even though no safe host route existed, creating a false affordance.
self_critique_and_repair.repair: Replaced the fake action with a noninteractive status token and exposed the durable thread reference separately. Preview remains actionable only when a route is known.

non_obvious_findings: The safest reusable boundary is a typed derived-state renderer, not a new shell or mutable dashboard authority.
Facultad and Alumnos are registered but still require durable binding/discovery; presenting guessed preview URLs would violate current project routing truth.
A useful free-worker-slot number must carry its derivation basis; the UI must not turn an unexplained number into decorative progress.
boundaries: This is an isolated candidate, not gh-pages Served output and not Current/Human Accepted.
The sample state is intentionally non-live; a durable Control Room/state compiler must provide real values later.
Prometeo móvil, Facultad and Alumnos preview routes remain unresolved in the sample rather than guessed.
Actual Page Change Thread actions/local Steward dispositions require their own durable returns/integration evidence.
Independent in-place execution of the committed node:test suite remains for a verifier/runtime with checkout access.

next_work_disposition.candidate: Bind multi-surface candidate to derived Control Room output
next_work_disposition.reason: O-SWARM-CONTROL-ROOM-PROJECTION-V1 plus later cross-surface integration already cover the upstream projection/integration path.

next_work_disposition.candidate: Resolve per-surface routes and Page Change Thread actions
next_work_disposition.reason: Surface truth/intent lanes and O-SWARM-PAGE-THREAD-BRIDGE-V1 already own this evidence; no new duplicate proposal emitted.

CP3 fail-closed model + committed invariants persisted
